allrebalanced:itemdesc-summoner-gear-nor: Can be shattered to summon Surface or Deep Rust creatures. A crude contraption, wrought by a madman whose curiosity about the other world outpaced his caution.
allrebalanced:itemdesc-summoner-gear-bel: Can be shattered in attempt to summon Bells. Distant peal haunts the ear whenever this accursed thing is held. No bell swings, yet still it tolls.
allrebalanced:itemdesc-summoner-gear-mut: Can be shattered to summon Double Headed and other high level Rust creatures. People turn away their gaze in disgust. Some truths offend the eye. But You know better than them.
allrebalanced:itemdesc-summoner-gear-tai: Can be shattered to summon Tainted or Corrupt Rust creatures. Made by the meddling hands of a mage's apprentice, infused with but a sliver of temporal energy.
allrebalanced:itemdesc-summoner-gear-nig: Can be shattered to summon Nightmare or Corrupt Rust creatures. Rust and rot slough from the thing. Something pitiful is waiting on the other side.
